name: stiffness degradation
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 结构在损伤或缺陷发展下刚度逐步降低。
usage_overview: 用于表征缺陷造成的力学性能下降。在考虑基底缺陷的隧道动力分析中，可通过折减等效接触刚度表示缺陷影响，考察相应缺陷状态下结构对列车作用的动力响应。

complete_examples.text: Experiments were conducted to measure the load-bearing capacity and stiffness degradation of the tunnel basement structure under different defect states.
The stiffness degradation coefficients for different states of basement defects were obtained (Table 4).
